grouping: identical salt molality, EC mass fraction and DMC co-solvent ratio; average all finite repeated observations; never split replicates
comparison: Paired identical initial sequences; total formulation experiments counted including warm start; each outcome hidden until selected; ties use a seeded order; no LLM sees pool answers.
limits: Replay is restricted to historically measured candidates, not unseen chemical space.

Calendar and laboratory savings require an actual prospective comparison.
Compare all methods and secondary thresholds; do not select only winning seeds.
